translations.web: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
translations.bsb: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
translations.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
translations.asv: No soldier on service entangleth himself in the affairs of this life; that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
